reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin that adds an interactive pixel-art gacha visualization triggered during message sending and scores predefined signals from streamed model text for entertainment.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 发送区添加可交互的 3D 拉杆和像素风抽卡演出，并根据模型流式文本信号生成娱乐性结算结果。
summaries.en: Adds an interactive 3D lever and pixel-art gacha presentation to DeepSeek Harness, generating an entertainment result from predefined signals in streamed model text.

capabilities: Adds an interactive 3D gacha interface beside the message send button
Reads streamed reasoning and response text to count predefined textual signals
Displays animations, result cards, generated audio, and live signal counts
Provides plugin routes for coordinating stream observations and client display state
